description: A class condition that tests an alphabet-name — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 16: "Class condition test with alphabet-name. The content of a data item can be tested against the coded character set named as alphabet-name." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, ConditionBinder.BindUserWordClassCondition, the alphabet-name arm (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: a class condition that tests an alphabet-name
citation: ISO §2023:8.8.4.4.4 GR3; ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 16
vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.47 - the 2002 Annex F.2 relaxations of COBOL-85 restrictions (item 16)
